mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.employee_no AS "employeeNo", u.username, u.real_name AS "realName", u.dept_id AS "deptId", d.name AS "dept", COALESCE((SELECT r.name FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id LIMIT 1), '普通员工') AS "role", u.status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE u.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY u.id
SELECT id, employee_no AS "employeeNo", username, real_name AS "realName", dept_id AS "deptId", status FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT u.id, u.employee_no AS "employeeNo", u.username, u.real_name AS "realName", u.dept_id AS "deptId", d.name AS "dept", COALESCE((SELECT r.name FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id LIMIT 1), '普通员工') AS "role", u.status FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = u.dept_id WHERE u.id = #{id} AND u.deleted = FALSE
SELECT password_hash FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user(employee_no, username, password_hash, real_name, email, phone, dept_id, status) VALUES(#{employeeNo}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{realName}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{deptId}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET real_name = COALESCE(#{realName}, real_name), email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), phone = COALESCE(#{phone}, phone), dept_id = COALESCE(#{deptId}, dept_id), status = COALESCE(#{status}, status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = TRUE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{hash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT setval(#{seqName}, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(id) FROM sys_user), 1))
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.dept_id AS "deptId", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'ROLE_ADMIN') AS "admin", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND p.perms = 'kb:view') AS "kbAccess", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.code = 'ROLE_KB_MANAGER') AS "kbManager" FROM sys_user u WHERE u.username = #{username} AND u.deleted = FALSE AND u.status = 1
SELECT last_login_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = #{time} WHERE id = #{id}
